description: OMENZ Loadout Compile: turn a loadout into the platform plan (nav2 action goals for ros-mcp, unitree_sdk2 calls, or MCP tools + an Authorize passport request) plus an Ed25519-signed install receipt (omenz.loadout-install.v0: allowed capabilities, speed/payload limits, no-go zones, confirm list, expiry). Dry-run plans from public SDK docs; OMENZ never sends commands to hardware. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/loadout/compile, $0.02 via x402.)

loadout.description: preset id (GET /v1/loadouts) or an omenz.loadout.v0 object

platform.description: platform profile id or a custom {id, native, addon} manifest
